title: Coffee Brand Identity Design Egypt — Kohi Bar Case Study | admepro
desc: admepro crafted the Kohi Bar brand identity — logo, visual language and packaging design for a specialty coffee brand with a bold, minimalist look.
content: P: Kohi Bar stands as a distinctive coffee destination, crafting unique coffee experiences through innovative brewing methods and carefully selected beans. Their artisanal approach elevates the everyday coffee ritual into something extraordinary.

H2: Our collaboration with Kohi Bar established their distinctive coffee with with presence.

P: The project encompassed creating a cohesive visual system, from distinctive packaging design to branded materials. Each element was thoughtfully designed to reflect Kohi Bar’s commitment to coffee craftsmanship, resulting in a brand experience that resonates with coffee connoisseurs.

P: We developed a comprehensive brand strategy that positioned Kohi Bar in the specialty coffee market. Our approach emphasized their unique brewing methods while creating an identity that speaks to modern coffee enthusiasts.
H2: Where Coffee Culture Meets Artistic Expression.

P: The Kohi Bar logo embodies the essence of modern coffee culture through clean, sophisticated design elements. The distinctive mark captures the artisanal spirit of coffee crafting while maintaining a contemporary edge that appeals to discerning coffee enthusiasts.

P: Our packaging design for Kohi Bar reflects a perfect blend of functionality and aesthetic appeal. Each element was crafted to showcase the premium quality of their coffee while creating an engaging unboxing experience that elevates the brand’s storytelling.
P: We’re a team of creatives who are excited about unique ideas and create amazing identity .
